raw_text: Suspected militants of the United Liberation Front of Asom (Independent) have sabotaged an Oil India Limited crude oil pipeline in Tinsukia district using improvised explosive devices placed at two valve stations along the Duliajan-Numaligarh corridor. The attack has caused a major oil spill affecting 12 hectares of wetland. Oil India Limited has shut down the pipeline section and deployed emergency response teams.
clean_text: ULFA-I sabotaged OIL pipeline in Tinsukia with IEDs at two valve stations. 12-hectare wetland oil spill. Pipeline section shut down, emergency response deployed.
